skill.name: govisit-search-availability
skill.description: Check one-room availability for a supported GoVisit hotel using your stay dates, guest details, and preferred currency. Review provider rates and open a booking link when available.
skill.summary: Check hotel availability and review provider rates for one room on GoVisit.
skill.author: inhotel-io

security_audit.summary: The documented search sends itinerary and occupancy data, including child ages when supplied, to GoVisit. The booking link requires HTTPS, but the contract does not restrict its destination to the expected provider. No evidence found of shell execution, local hidden-file access, system reconnaissance, or prompt injection.

remediation.issue: Hotel searches disclose itinerary and occupancy details to GoVisit.
remediation.suggestion: Tell users which fields GoVisit receives before sending their first search. Send only required search fields and optional values the user has agreed to share.

remediation.issue: Returned booking links are not restricted to the expected provider domain.
remediation.suggestion: Require booking links to match a trusted domain for the selected provider. Check redirect destinations before following them, and keep checkout under user control.

content.value_statement: A hotel profile may not show whether a room is available for your exact dates and guest group. GoVisit checks supported hotels and reports provider rates and booking links when available.
actual_capabilities: Check one room at a supported hotel using its GoVisit profile, check-in date, check-out date, and adult count.
Include child ages at check-in and request a supported quote currency.
Distinguish confirmed sellouts from unsupported requests, provider outages, and rate limits.
Show room types, rate plans, and stay totals, plus taxes or refundability when supplied.
Report when the provider checked availability and whether it flagged currency or occupancy.
Present a booking link when supplied and indicate whether it covers only dates or the full itinerary.
limitations: The supplied contract covers one room at a supported hotel, not restaurants, activities, tours, or transport.
Providers may not support the requested occupancy or currency. The skill does not substitute different dates, guest counts, or currencies.
The availability observation can be up to four hours old. Checkout confirms final price, availability, and terms.
The skill does not reserve rooms, take payments, or guarantee a booking link.

use_cases.title: Check a Weekend Stay
use_cases.description: Check whether a hotel from your shortlist has a room for your dates and review its reported stay total.

use_cases.title: Check Family Occupancy
use_cases.description: Check whether a provider supports your adult count and children's ages. Review any occupancy warnings before checkout.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Hotel Quote
use_cases.description: Summarize a provider's stay total, currency, and observation time before sharing a quote with a traveler.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Room
prompt_templates.prompt: Check one room for two adults at [GoVisit hotel profile] from [check-in date] to [check-out date].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you have selected a hotel and know your dates.

prompt_templates.title: Request a Quote Currency
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [GoVisit hotel profile] from [check-in date] to [check-out date] for [adult count] adults. Request [currency] and report stay totals in the currency returned.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need to compare the quote with a budget.

prompt_templates.title: Check Family Occupancy
prompt_templates.prompt: Check one room at [GoVisit hotel profile] from [check-in date] to [check-out date]. Use [adult count] adults and [child ages at check-in]. Report occupancy warnings without changing the guest details.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need to confirm whether a provider supports children in one room.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Provider Quote
prompt_templates.prompt: Check [GoVisit hotel profile] for [stay dates], [adult count] adults, and [currency]. Report the status, observation time, and provider warnings. For offers, list room types, rate plans, stay totals, and refundability if supplied. Say whether a booking link covers dates only or the full itinerary.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when preparing a quote for someone else to review before checkout.

output_examples.input: Show the stay total for two adults at the linked hotel from December 19 to 21, 2026, in euros.
output: Illustrative result: One double room is available for two adults.
Flexible rate: EUR 240 for the stay. The provider last checked at 14:30 UTC.
The booking link includes your dates only. Confirm guest details and final pricing at checkout.

output_examples.input: Check the linked hotel for two adults and a seven-year-old child from December 19 to 21, 2026.
output: Illustrative result: The provider does not support the requested occupancy.
This does not mean the hotel is sold out. The dates and guest details were not changed.

best_practices: Use the canonical GoVisit hotel profile and provide exact stay dates and guest counts.
Share only the guest details needed for the search. Do not include names, contact details, or payment information.
Keep the observation time and reported currency with each quote. Confirm final price and guest details at checkout.
anti_patterns: Treat an unsupported or unavailable response as a confirmed sellout.
Change stay dates, occupancy, or currency without asking the traveler.
Treat a rate quote or booking link as a confirmed reservation.

faq.question: What can I check?
faq.answer: The skill checks one room at a supported hotel with a GoVisit profile and a connected provider.

faq.question: What information does GoVisit receive?
faq.answer: GoVisit receives the hotel page, stay dates, and adult count, plus child ages and currency when supplied. No account credentials are required.

faq.question: Which currencies can I request?
faq.answer: You can request EUR, USD, CAD, GBP, AUD, JPY, or CZK. EUR is the default, but a provider may not support the requested currency.

faq.question: Can I search for children or multiple rooms?
faq.answer: You can include children's ages for one room if the provider supports them. The skill does not search for multiple rooms in one request.

faq.question: How current is the availability result?
faq.answer: The observation can be up to four hours old. Check the reported observation time and confirm current availability at checkout.

faq.question: Does the skill complete a booking?
faq.answer: No. It can show a provider link when one is returned. You complete the reservation on the provider's site.
